For a contour product $A=BC$, Langreth's rules give
\begin{eqnarray}\label{rules}
A^r(t,t') && = \int dt_1 B^r(t,t_1)C^r(t_1,t') \nonumber\\
A^<(t,t') && = \int dt_1 [B^r(t,t_1)C^<(t_1,t') \nonumber\\
&& \qquad +B^<(t,t_1)C^a(t_1,t')]
\end{eqnarray}
\begin{equation}\label{wrong}
A^<(t,t') = \int dt_1 [B^r(t,t_1)C^<(t_1,t') + B^<(t,t_1)C^r(t_1,t')]
\end{equation}
